# Merge into Current Tab (a tab's menu, where the tabs are listed): another
# tab's panes join the tab in front, beside its focused pane, arranged as
# they were — one block, to its right; its parked panes come along, parked;
# its tab goes. It's a move: nothing restarts (the sleep keeps going, and
# what a program prints afterwards shows here), and the keyboard stays in
# the pane that had it. Read back as the tabs' rows, the split's layout and
# the shells' text. tests/run.sh runs it with --persist (the roundtrip
# saves the layout by session).
type:echo HOME-PANE
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect-layout:a
# Tab 2: two panes side by side, and a third parked out of the split.
tab:new
wait:0.5
type:echo SOURCE-LEFT; sleep 4.@N@; echo AFTER-MOVE; sleep 299.@N@
key:enter
wait:0.6
key:cmd+d
wait:1.5
type:echo SOURCE-RIGHT
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:SOURCE-RIGHT
key:cmd+d
wait:1.5
type:echo PARKED-ONE
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:PARKED-ONE
action:park_surface
wait:0.8
expect-panes:2
expect-tab:2 panes · 1 parked
# Zoomed, it unzooms as it goes.
action:toggle_split_zoom
wait:0.3
expect-zoomed:yes
# Not offered on the tab in front.
tab-menu-not:2:Merge into Current Tab
tab:1
wait:0.5
tab-menu-not:1:Merge into Current Tab
tab-menu:2:Merge into Current Tab
wait:0.5
expect-tab-count:1
expect-panes:3
expect-zoomed:no
expect-layout:h50(a,h50(b,c))
expect-tab:3 panes · 1 parked
expect-tab-not:zoomed
# The keyboard is where it was: what's typed shows in the first pane.
expect-focus:1
type:echo TYPED-$((40+2))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:TYPED-42
expect:SOURCE-LEFT
# Its programs ran on through the move. (Not what a prompt drew before it:
# a shell may redraw its prompt over that, narrower now.)
wait:3.5
expect:AFTER-MOVE
expect-shell:echo n=$(pgrep -f 'sleep 299[.]@N@$' | wc -l | tr -d ' ') ==> n=1
shot:move-into-tab.png
# The parked pane is this tab's now: it comes back here, running as it was.
action:unpark_surface
wait:0.8
expect-panes:4
expect-tab-not:parked
expect:PARKED-ONE
type:echo UNPARKED-$((40+3))
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:UNPARKED-43
# Saved and built again: one tab, its panes as they are.
roundtrip:go
# Not offered for a document's tab, nor while a document is in front.
open:/etc/hosts
wait:0.6
expect-tab-count:2
tab-menu-not:2:Merge into Current Tab
tab-menu-not:1:Merge into Current Tab
tab:1
wait:0.4
tab-menu-not:2:Merge into Current Tab
